prompt:
These are the lyrics (in Portuguese) of the song "Choro das Águas" by Brazilian singer Ivan Lins from 1977:
```
Esse meu choro não cabe no peito
Arde por dentro e rola na face
Molha por fora e estraga o disfarce
Lava esse coração

Esse meu choro é muito doído
Me corta a fala, me tapa os ouvidos
Me fere os olhos com vidro moído
Sangra esse coração

Esse meu choro é o choro das águas
Que lava as telhas, que rola nas calhas
Que pinga nas bicas e deságua na gente
Afoga esse coração.
```

And this is a translation by a native Portuguese speaker:
```
This cry of mine doesn't fit in my heart
It burns on the inside and rolls on the face
It wets on the outside and ruins the disguise
It washes off this heart

This cry of mine is so painful
It leaves me speechless, it covers my ears
It wounds my eyes with ground waste glass
It bleeds off this heart 

This cry of mine is the water's cry
That washes the tiles, that rolls on the gutters
That drips out from the spouts and flows into us
That drowns this heart.
```

Is this translation accurate? Can you suggest any improvements?
response:
